integration_decision.name: FAIL_CLOSED_ON_UNWITNESSED_B_OVERTAKE_IN_P0_NEGATIVE_CONTROL
integration_decision.finding: Pinned pytest_source uses `if b_latest.wait(10): ...` with no else. If B is not scheduled until after A is released, unchanged unprotected code can finish with all-B stamps and pass the strengthened coherence assertion vacuously. This is a harness non-vacuity risk, not a confirmed production result.
no_network_contract: Run unchanged `python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests` first on authorized exact-SHA disposable Linux checkout; capture raw exit/stdout/stderr.
Materialize pinned pytest_source as test-only uncommitted overlay; verify blob/hash. Record a_latest, b_latest, release_a, both thread completion/errors and final 3-file stamp vector.

For unchanged-code P0 negative control require b_latest fired BEFORE release_a and both writers finished; if not, mark INCONCLUSIVE even when final stamps are coherent. Only witnessed [1800000060000,1800000000000,1800000000000] is valid RED defect evidence.

After separately authorized Gemini-only repair, the identical test with conditional release must finish both writers and show [1800000060000,1800000060000,1800000060000]; run targeted `python -m pytest -q -rs part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py` and full `python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests`. Do not require b_latest before release_a for a correctly serialized GREEN path.
Reader snapshot atomicity and cross-process archive admission remain distinct acceptance gates; no new source changes or task queued.
